name: zp-school-management-system
description: School Management System for Zilla Parishad Primary School, Hingone BK

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "green,blue" "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.vercel:install: npm ci --include=dev && npm ci --prefix server --include=dev && npm ci --prefix client --include=dev
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
